title: Pharaoh Thutmose III (Napoleon of Egypt)
kingdom: New Kingdom of Egypt (The Imperial Age)
biography: Master military strategist who led 17 successful foreign campaigns, winning the Battle of Megiddo and expanding Egyptian imperial borders from the Euphrates in Syria to the Fourth Cataract in Nubia.
internationalConnections: Established tributary relations with Babylon, the Mitanni Empire, Assyria, and the Hittites.
